close_reason: Fixed in 8398e6cfe: stable semantic suspension/resumption assertions replace allocator-order function rendering.
description:
GOAL

Make enum_reduce_suspend prove the semantic suspension boundary without depending on allocator-order function numbering.

SIGNAL

Adding two unrelated functions to lib/enum.fz changes the rendered continuation from #fn<125/0> to #fn<127/0> on interp, JIT, and AOT. Allocation counters and behavior are unchanged. The fixture prose already says schema/function numbering is not semantic, but expected.txt and expected.interp.txt still pin the number. The prose also carries stale historical IDs and tactical implementation notes instead of a durable statement of the behavior under test.

STRATEGY

Pattern-match the suspended result into a stable summary, capture allocation stats before resuming, then invoke the returned zero-arity function and assert its completed reduction result. Remove the historical commentary. Keep the allocation goldens that prove a real heap closure exists and preserve the separate interpreter/native counts.

ACCEPTANCE

- No golden or fixture prose names a numeric function ID.
- The fixture proves the suspended accumulator, the closure allocation boundary, and the resumed result.
- interp, JIT, and AOT legs pass before any dependent library surface is pushed.
- The full fixture matrix remains green.

comments.text: Landed as 8398e6cfe. The fixture now destructures the suspended result into {:suspended, acc}, records the allocation boundary before any observation-created tuple can contaminate it, and invokes the returned zero-arity continuation to prove {:done, 6}. Removed the allocator-order #fn golden and 42 lines of stale/historical commentary. Native retains one 48-byte closure; interp retains its existing two closures/64 bytes; neither path boxes the accumulator. Verified target 3/3, full fixture matrix 724/724, compiler lib 2020 passed/6 ignored, runtime 260/260, CLI 30/30, doctests, AOT variadic open, clippy -D warnings, fmt, diff check, no generated actuals, and an explicit tactical-prose/function-ID scan.

Final rebased SHA b3204097c is published as draft PR #147: https://github.com/jallum/fz/pull/147. Its immediate support PR #139 was CLEAN, MERGEABLE, and fully green before submission. Final local gates: target 3/3, fixture matrix 754/754, compiler library 2060 passed/5 ignored, runtime 269/269, CLI 30/30, doctests, AOT variadic integration, strict Clippy, formatting, and diff hygiene.
